rows.reviewerNote: Checked as it will land. The stem and window [8, 9] agree. 'Rushed out all of a sudden.' is the only correct sense of 'bolted out of the house', and line 9's coat detail confirms it. The eating, door-locking, ladder and shouting options are each wrong. There is no positional or length pattern giving the key away. The words are suitable for 9-11-year-olds.

There is no pattern giving the key away, and the words are suitable for 9-11-year-olds.
